evidence.section: Preparation of samples for GeneChip analysis
evidence.quote: Preparation of cellular RNA and subsequent processing for GeneChip analysis were performed as described elsewhere [28], by use of the HG-U133 A 2.0 and HG-U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChips (Affymetrix)

real time polymerase chain reaction assa.readouts: fluorescence signals and fold changes in expression of PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4

evidence.quote: Real-time polymerase chain reaction. To confirm observations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.

microscopy assay.readouts: detection of parasite and parasitemia after challenge

evidence.quote: Infection with malaria was determined by detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears during the 30 days after challenge.
